title: GitHub Copilot deprecated four models on October 2, including Claude Opus 4.7
detail: Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash, Kimi K2.7 Code and Claude Opus 4.7 are deprecated across all Copilot experiences as of October 2, 2026. Suggested replacements are Gemini 3.8 Flash for both Gemini models, Kimi K3, and Claude Opus 5.5. Enterprise administrators are told to enable the alternative models through Copilot policy settings.
impact: This is separate from the October 19 cutoff already listed. If your workflows or integrations select Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemini 3.6 Flash or Kimi K2.7 Code in Copilot, move them to a supported model. The changelog does not state the replacements' credit cost, so check their rates before switching.
